datasets.name: Engine Bay Parts

datasets.license: MIT as declared on the Roboflow Universe project page
datasets.terms_note: Best direct detection source. Preserve the original split and remap only named classes reviewed in engine_bay_class_map.yaml.

classes: 0 through 25 (invalid numeric placeholder labels; manual audit required)

datasets.name: ARabeitak Toyota Corolla Car Parts
datasets.scope: 1,353 image files in the pinned snapshot; 8 class folders plus one sample image; classification/folder labels only
datasets.license: Apache-2.0 according to the Hugging Face dataset metadata
datasets.terms_note: Captured from one Toyota Corolla 2015, so avoid vehicle-identity leakage across train/val. The pinned repository contains 1,353 images: the published Coolant Reservoir count is split across Coolant Reservoir (246) and an undocumented New Coolant Reservoir folder (50), plus one root sample image. Folder labels are not bounding boxes or masks; run detection/segmentation annotation before YOLO training. Reservoir Cap is ambiguous and Engine must not be silently mapped to Engine Cover.
datasets.citation: Wagdy, Hany, Raafat, Albert et al., ARabeitak Car Parts Object Detection Dataset, graduation project, 2023
